subject.title: Feature Request: Stream Repetition Safeguard (Halt & Confirm)

question: What product contract should OpenClaw use when a model repeatedly streams identical or cyclic assistant text: abort-only, pause-and-confirm, retry/failover, session rollback, or some combination?
rationale: The source boundary is clear, but default strictness, false-positive tolerance, whether an approve command should resume a suspect stream, and how to sanitize session history are product and compatibility decisions automation should not invent.

options.title: Approve a core guard contract
options.body: Define default thresholds, alert wording, abort/retry/resume behavior, and session cleanup, then implement the guard in the embedded-agent stream path with regression and live-channel proof.

options.title: Abort and quarantine only
options.body: Permit a detector that aborts and quarantines the bad turn without a manual resume path, reducing the chance of continuing poisoned output.

options.title: Defer to timeout work
options.body: Keep this issue open while timeout and provider-watchdog decisions settle, accepting that active repeated text can still bypass idle timeout.

recommendation.title: Approve a core guard contract
recommendation.body: Define default thresholds, alert wording, abort/retry/resume behavior, and session cleanup, then implement the guard in the embedded-agent stream path with regression and live-channel proof.
